cues.en: Hello and welcome back.
cues.zh: 你好，歡迎回來。

cues.en: Today we've got CloudFormation, which is a very important, very useful tool in AWS.
cues.zh: 今天談 CloudFormation，AWS 很重要、實用的工具。

cues.en: Imagine you want to, or need to, deploy infrastructure.
cues.zh: 假設需要部署基礎設施。

cues.en: Well, you could do that through the AWS console or you could do that through the AWS CLI or SDK.
cues.zh: 可用 AWS 主控台，也可 CLI 或 SDK。

cues.en: There are ways of doing it manually or programmatically, but what CloudFormation does, it takes this to a next level.
cues.zh: 有手動、程式化方式，但 CloudFormation 更進一步。

cues.en: You can write infrastructure as code and deploy it all together into your AWS account in one go.
cues.zh: 以程式碼撰寫基礎設施，一次部署到 AWS 帳戶。

cues.en: Very, very powerful tool.
cues.zh: 非常強大。

cues.en: Wouldn't be surprised if it comes up on the exam.
cues.zh: 考試出現也不意外。

cues.en: So let's see how this works.
cues.zh: 看看運作。

cues.en: For CloudFormation, you need to first write a template, and that template can be written either in YAML or JSON.
cues.zh: 先寫範本，可用 YAML 或 JSON。

cues.en: And from there, that template gets uploaded into CloudFormation, and that template describes all of the resources that you want to be created.
cues.zh: 上傳 CloudFormation，描述想建立的全部資源。

cues.en: For example, it might be an EC2 instance, it might be an S3 bucket, it might be a fleet of instances, it might be RDS, it might be anything.
cues.zh: 例如 EC2、S3、執行個體群、RDS，任何東西。

cues.en: Whatever you think of that you need in AWS to be created, you can write it out in this template, upload it to CloudFormation, and then once you run it,
cues.zh: AWS 需要建立的資源，都能寫範本、上傳、執行，

cues.en: it'll create a stack which can be deployed in any region.
cues.zh: 建立堆疊，可部署到任何區域。

cues.en: And the beauty of these templates is that once it's written, you can use it in any account.
cues.zh: 美妙的是，寫好就能在任何帳戶使用。

cues.en: It's not limited to just the account that you use, that, you know, one of your accounts.
cues.zh: 不局限原帳戶。

cues.en: You can take it to another account and apply it there and it will work the same way every single time.
cues.zh: 換另一個帳戶套用，每次都同樣運作。

cues.en: And let's look at an example.
cues.zh: 看例子。

cues.en: Let's say we want to create an S3 bucket, an EC2 instance, and for that EC2 instance to have access to that S3 bucket.
cues.zh: 建立 S3、EC2，讓 EC2 可存取 S3。

cues.en: This is what the CloudFormation template would look like.
cues.zh: CloudFormation 範本長這樣。

cues.en: We would have the S3 bucket, which would have some certain properties, which we would need to specify.
cues.zh: S3 有一些要指定的屬性。

cues.en: Among them, there would be a globally unique name.
cues.zh: 包括全域唯一名稱。

cues.en: Of course, this is important.
cues.zh: 當然重要。

cues.en: We know that S3 buckets have globally unique names.
cues.zh: 知道 S3 名稱全域唯一。

cues.en: Also, we would have the EC2 instance.
cues.zh: 也有 EC2。

cues.en: Again, there would be properties that we would describe in the template of the EC2 instance, like what AMI we want to use, what size of the instance, what type of the instance,
cues.zh: 範本描述屬性，例如 AMI、執行個體大小、類型，

cues.en: and things like that.
cues.zh: 等等。

cues.en: Security group and stuff, (chuckles) and other things.
cues.zh: 安全群組及其他。

cues.en: Then we would also have an EC2 instance role, because we want the EC2 instance to have access to the S3 bucket.
cues.zh: 也有 EC2 角色，因為要存取 S3。

cues.en: But that doesn't stop there, because in AWS, you need to also describe inside the role
cues.zh: 但還不只，AWS 角色還需描述，

cues.en: who can do what, (chuckles) who can and do what.
cues.zh: 誰能做什麼。

cues.en: So who can is the EC2 instance, accessing the S3 bucket.
cues.zh: 誰，就是 EC2，能存取 S3。

cues.en: But that doesn't stop there.
cues.zh: 還沒結束。

cues.en: We also need to set up a security group for our EC2 instance, which we will also describe, and we will also set up an EC2 instance profile,
cues.zh: 需要設定 EC2 安全群組，也描述在裡面，並設定 Instance profile，

cues.en: which will link the EC2 instance role to the EC2 instance.
cues.zh: 連接角色與 EC2。

cues.en: It's a bit more advanced.
cues.zh: 稍微進階。

cues.en: We won't go into detail on this, but that's how it works in (chuckles) AWS.
cues.zh: 不深入，但 AWS 就這樣運作。

cues.en: You set up an EC2 instance with a profile.
cues.zh: EC2 搭配執行個體設定檔。

cues.en: In the profile, you specify the instance role or roles that that profile will have access to.
cues.zh: 設定檔裡指定可用的執行個體角色。

cues.en: So this is like a very simple CloudFormation template, but as you can already see, it's very powerful every time you deploy this CloudFormation template,
cues.zh: 這是很簡單範本，但已非常強大，每次部署，

cues.en: which you will see in the practical tutorial with Hadelin, how to create it.
cues.zh: Hadelin 實作會展示如何建立，

cues.en: Once you have it, you can deploy it in any account and every time it will create this setup the same exact way.
cues.zh: 取得後可在任何帳戶部署，每次都產生相同設定。

cues.en: And imagine you create a much more complex CloudFormation template that will help you reuse or recreate your setup, and as a result, our EC2 instance will have access
cues.zh: 想像更複雜範本，可重用、重建環境，最後 EC2 能存取

cues.en: to the S3 bucket.
Now, another thing to note is that not only can you create resources with a CloudFormation template, you can actually delete all of these resources
cues.zh: 另一點，不只能建立資源，還能用範本將全部資源，

cues.en: with one click.
cues.zh: 一鍵刪除。

cues.en: It supports one-click deletion.
cues.zh: 支援一鍵刪除。

cues.en: Delete the stack, and it deletes the whole set of your resources that were created, so it's extremely powerful in that sense as well.
cues.zh: 刪堆疊，就刪其中建立的全部資源，這也非常強大。

cues.en: So there you go, can't wait for you to check out the practical tutorial with Hadelin where you will recreate all of this, and here's a quick summary about CloudFormation.
cues.zh: 期待你看 Hadelin 實作，重建這些，這裡快速整理 CloudFormation。

cues.en: I look forward to seeing you in the next tutorial, and until then, enjoy the cloud.
cues.zh: 期待下一堂見，在那之前，享受雲端的樂趣吧。
